dealport.description: Search 28M+ US private companies and commercial buildings with primary public-filing cited Records, free market sizing (preview_companies) and CSV list matching (match_company_list), living Projects and Playbooks, verified human owner contacts, and double-opt-in Warm Yes introductions via Avery (Dealport's AI outreach specialist, who always discloses she is an AI). Sign in with OAuth (/mcp in Claude Code) or pass a Bearer API key; new accounts start with a $5.00 free balance on pay-as-you-go USD rates. Docs: https://dealport.com/docs
